title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Coliseum on 1973-06-22
lineage: AUDMC > Reel > Reel > CD > DAT > WAV > SHN recorded by Donn Amick, FOB, Sony EMC mics spread out across the row > TC-126 master cassette > Amick's Reel recorded at 7-1/2ips > Matt Williams' Reel at 3-3/4ips w/ Dolby(Teac AN-60)

ai_review.summary: A superb audience tape of a classic ’73 show with an epic He's Gone/48 Chambers of Phil jam and one of the best Bird Songs ever, captured in excellent stereo warmth.
ai_review.review: The recording is widely praised as an outstanding audience (AUD) capture – rich, full‑room sound with near‑perfect stereo separation despite a few minor fade‑outs early on. Musically the concert is hailed as a hidden gem: soaring Jerry solos, Keith’s Chick‑Corea‑style keyboards, and a monster second‑set jam that includes He’s Gone → 48 Chambers of Phil → Ecstasy/Bliss/Terror/Amazement, plus a legendary Bird Song. Overall fans consider it one of the top ’73 performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 5 stars, praising both performance and recording; only a handful note minor audio glitches, yielding an overall rating in the high‑4 range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised for perfect stereo image, rich room ambience and full instrument separation. A few reviewers note early fade‑outs in "Bertha", occasional tape hiss and brief cut‑outs, but these are considered minor blemishes on an otherwise outstanding AUD.

standout_songs: He's Gone > 48 Chambers of Phil > Ecstasy/Bliss/Terror/Amazement jam
show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans describe the setlist as killer and tightly paced, with a classic ’73 vibe that builds into a soaring second‑set jam. The flow from upbeat numbers into expansive improvisations is highlighted as a major strength.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for soulful, inspired solos and a rich guitar tone throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for his re‑emergence in the jam, especially the "48 Chambers of Phil" segment and tight bass work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboards receive high marks – described as Chick‑Corea‑esque circles during the jam.
